title: Los Angeles
location: Los Angeles, United States of America
subtitle: Los Angeles is a sprawling Southern California city and the center of the nation’s film and television industry. Near its iconic Hollywood sign, studios such as Paramount Pictures, Universal and Warner Brothers offer behind-the-scenes tours. On Hollywood Boulevard, TCL Chinese Theatre displays celebrities’ hand- and footprints, the Walk of Fame honors thousands of luminaries and vendors sell maps to stars’ homes.

title: Unkai Maru No.6
subtitle: The Unkai Maru No.6 is a popular wreck in Chuuk Lagoon, originally built in 1905 as a cargo ship. It rests upright in 40 metres of water. Divers explore its well-preserved holds, coral-encrusted masts, and the iconic bow gun, making it a haunting yet beautiful testament to WWII maritime history.

title: Yubae Maru
subtitle: The Yubae Maru is a captivating shipwreck in Chuuk Lagoon, resting at a depth of 35 meters. Originally a Japanese merchant ship. Today, its well-preserved hull and coral-encrusted structures offer a hauntingly beautiful dive, showcasing vibrant marine life and a poignant glimpse into World War II maritime history.
